name: M-EQ-01 renamed item in ExtraSlots equipment and extra slots

steps.message: You wear a cape renamed "Slot Test Cape" (crafted by you). Open your inventory (Tab) and hover the cape in its ExtraSlots equipment slot (Back): the tooltip title must say Slot Test Cape, not Deer Hide Cape, with the Crafted-by line. Then drag it into an extra slot (quick / misc) and hover again, and also check the same for a renamed item in the food or ammo slot. Pass only if every slot shows the new name. Mark Fail if not.
